title: 第一卷 第13章 威慑第一卷 第14章 收尸
lines: 林风眠正想直接激活眼前玉佩中的力量，震慑一下眼前的妖女。
但柳媚突然鬼魅一般出现在他面前，轻笑一声。
“我就逼你怎么了？”
林风眠还没反应过来，她就一口香气吐在他脸上。
林风眠只感觉一股燥热从小腹升起，不由心中一惊。
不好，这香气有毒！
他还没来得及做任何反应，就感觉头昏眼胀，满脑子都是男女之事。
这是玉仙宗专门用来魅惑男子的缠绵香，能勾起人的情欲。
林风眠此刻看着性感撩人的柳媚，只想将这妖女给剥了，就地正法。
他死死盯着柳媚，双目发红，呼吸都急促了起来。
柳媚见状轻笑一声，缓缓贴近林风眠，温香软玉压在他身上，媚眼如丝。
她在他耳边呵气如兰道：“怎么样，改变主意了没？”
林风眠感受到那惊人的柔软，本能地一把抱住她，像是想将她揉进自己体内。
柳媚皱起眉头，嗔怪道：“轻点，你弄疼我了！”
林风眠听到这话，理智更是直接阵亡了。
眼看就要一念之插，他胸前的玉佩突然亮了起来，一股冰凉之气涌入。
林风眠顿时一个哆嗦，找回了一丝理智，惊恐地推开柳媚。
柳媚娇呼一声，踉踉跄跄后退几步，一脸惊讶看着林风眠。
她真没想到林风眠居然在中了缠绵香后，还能有毅力推开自己。
“看来姐姐小看你了呢！”
柳媚舔了舔红唇，笑道：“不过你又能抗得了多久呢？”
她一边款款走来，一边将外衫给褪去，显山露水，露出傲人的资本。
林风眠咬牙道：“你不要过来，不然我可不客气了！”
柳媚不以为然，娇笑道：“那我倒要看看你要怎么个不客气法？”
虽然这妖女一边卸甲，一边步步紧逼，林风眠却不敢给敌人致命一击。
毕竟这可不是手无缚鸡之力的柔弱女子，而是擅长舞枪弄棒，能手缚苍龙的妖女！
“柳媚，你逼我的！”
林风眠不再犹豫，手中飞快掐诀。
他胸前玉佩顿时亮了起来，一股凌厉的寒冰剑意汹涌而出。
林风眠脚下凝结出一层寒冰，以极快的速度扩散开去。
柳媚顿时吓了一大跳，迅速倒退几步，惊讶地看着林风眠。
content_en:
Lin Fengmian was about to directly activate the power in the jade pendant in front of him to scare the witch in front of him.
But Liu Mei suddenly appeared in front of him like a ghost and chuckled.
"What's wrong with me forcing you?"
Before Lin Fengmian could react, she spit the scent on his face.
Lin Fengmian felt a heat rising from his lower abdomen, and couldn't help but feel shocked.
No, this aroma is poisonous!
Before he had time to react, he felt dizzy and dizzy, and his mind was filled with things between men and women.
This is the lingering fragrance specially used by the Jade Immortal Sect to charm men, and can arouse people's lust.
Lin Fengmian was looking at the sexy and sultry Liu Mei, and he just wanted to skin the witch and execute her on the spot.
He stared at Liu Mei, his eyes red and his breathing quickened.
Upon seeing this, Liu Mei chuckled and slowly approached Lin Fengmian. The warm fragrant soft jade pressed against him, her eyes as charming as silk.
She breathed softly into his ear and said, "How's it going? Have you changed your mind?"
林风眠感受到那惊人的柔软，本能地一把抱住她，像是想将她揉进自己体内。
"Ah!"
Liu Mei frowned and said angrily: "Be gentle, you're hurting me!"
When Lin Fengmian heard this, his reason was immediately killed.
Just when he was about to have a thought, the jade pendant on his chest suddenly lit up, and a cold air poured in.
Lin Fengmian suddenly trembled, regained some sense, and pushed Liu Mei away in horror.
Liu Meiqiao let out a cry, staggered back a few steps, and looked at Lin Fengmian in surprise.
She really didn't expect that Lin Fengmian would still have the willpower to push her away after being intoxicated by the lingering fragrance.
"It seems that my sister underestimates you!"
Liu Mei licked her red lips and smiled: "But how long can you resist?"
As she walked forward, she took off her outer blouse, showing off her beauty and pride.
林风眠咬牙道：“你不要过来，不然我可不客气了！”
Liu Mei disagreed and said with a sweet smile: "Then I want to see how you can be rude?"
Although the witch was removing her armor and pressing forward step by step, Lin Fengmian did not dare to deliver a fatal blow to the enemy.
After all, this is not a weak woman with no power to bind a chicken, but a witch who is good at dancing with a spear and wielding a stick, and can bind a blue dragon with her hands!
"Liu Mei, you forced me!"
Lin Fengmian no longer hesitated and quickly made the secret in his hand.
The jade pendant on his chest suddenly lit up, and a sharp ice sword intent surged out.
林风眠脚下凝结出一层寒冰，以极快的速度扩散开去。
Liu Mei was immediately startled, quickly took a few steps back, and looked at Lin Fengmian in surprise.
